name: Walk-Forward Multivariate Baseline
purpose: Test whether combining only the nonredundant R2.1 candidates improves future SPY-relative return ranking.
Test a separate AVOID classifier for future bottom-quintile relative performers.
Require completely point-in-time training cutoffs for every walk-forward fold.
Require the data to earn FAVOR evidence rather than assuming a symmetric FAVOR classifier exists.
principles: R3 uses only features marked SELECTED by R2.1 for the applicable horizon.
No production Patch 6 score, state, Path Risk, weekly recommendation, or AI input is used.
No tree model, boosting model, neural network, or hyperparameter search is used.
The regression and classifier regularization settings are frozen before running R3.
Feature values are converted to point-in-time within-date percentile ranks before modeling.
Each model is trained once at the start of a test calendar year and remains fixed for that test year.
Training rows are eligible only when their outcome end date is strictly before the test-year cutoff.
R3 is development evidence because R1-R2.1 used the same 2016-2026 history for feature discovery; R3 is not a pristine untouched holdout.

avoid_target.definition: bottom 20% of future SPY-relative return within each anchor-date cross-section

bootstrap.method: moving block bootstrap over monthly evaluation metrics

requires: mean monthly IC 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
top-decile mean SPY-relative return 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
top-decile SPY-beating rate 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.50
top-quintile minus bottom-quintile relative-return spread 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
mean monthly ROC AUC 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.50
top predicted-risk quintile precision 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.20
top predicted-risk quintile mean SPY-relative return 95% bootstrap CI upper bound < 0
